## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Padumuttarabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 12) is the twelfth chapter of the canonical Pali *Buddhavaṁsa*, located in the late sutta division of the Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Translated by Bhikkhu Sujato under the title *The History of the Buddha Padumuttara*, the text recounts the life and dispensation of the past Buddha Padumuttara [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral indexes two modern translations across two languages [SuttaCentral].

According to machine-calculated text-reuse data from DharmaNexus, the text shares 519 passages with 37 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The largest Pali reuse partner is its commentary, the *Buddhavaṃsa-aṭṭhakathā*, which contains 180 matching passages (exceeding 13,000 characters, with the longest match at §14.4–18.4) [DharmaNexus]. Substantial reuse is also found in the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā* (28 matches) and across other chapters of the *Buddhavaṁsa*—especially the biographical accounts of the Buddhas Nārada (Bv 11), Maṅgala (Bv 5), Piyadassī (Bv 15), and Sikhī (Bv 22)—largely consisting of recurrent formulaic sequences detailing the lives of previous Buddhas (such as §19/20–27) [DharmaNexus]. Beyond the Pali canon, DharmaNexus aligns passages of the text with Sanskrit literature, most notably the *Mahāvastu-avadāna* (6 matches, highest score 65 at §5.4–6.1) and the *Ahorātravratacaityasevānuśaṃsāvadāna*, as well as several Tibetan canonical works, though these machine-identified cross-linguistic alignments are not corroborated as established parallels by SuttaCentral [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
